evd_title: GPT-4 Turbo achieved 70.0% overall accuracy on quotation error detection with title plus abstract plus excerpts
finding: GPT-4 Turbo achieved 70.0% overall accuracy on quotation error detection with title plus abstract plus excerpts
P: 250 statement-reference pairs from earlier studies, PubPeer and PubMed; expert-annotated quotation-error benchmark
I: GPT-4 Turbo (gpt-4-0125-preview), zero-shot; inputs: title + abstract + reference excerpts (best), or title + PDF via Assistant API
C: GPT-4o, GPT-3.5 Turbo; input settings (title, title+abstract, +excerpts, +PDF); expert labels
O: Overall accuracy: GPT-4 Turbo title+abstract+excerpts 70.0% (title+PDF 67.6%) vs best GPT-4o 68.0%, best GPT-3.5 Turbo 68.0%
S: Cross-sectional zero-shot benchmark on held-out expert-annotated quotation-error set
